note: Whole-package export of one reviewed commit; no local overlays. It supersedes the earlier 216d24ee base plus verbatim overlays (capability refresh, directory Tabs, Agent Roles, project groups, Tab visibility, session diagnostics, message references, session usage), all of which the shared runtime now carries. This commit adds the schedules contract (schedules, scheduleDetail, scheduleCommand) and its handler, which opens `<workspace>:sr` (Flock registry: bootstrap, create, append) and `<workspace>:schedule:<id>` (Loro document: create, bootstrap, append) and depends on loro-mirror 2.3.2.
